Hakushu 12 Year Old Description

A beautifully peated release from Suntory's Hakushu distillery, this award-winning whisky sits at 43% abv, making it light and smooth, yet with a powerful palate of flavours reminiscent of its forest home on Mt. Kaikomagatake.

Back to top

Hamish Says...

Our Hamish has had a sip and jotted down his thoughts.

Nose: Toasted seeds and nuts, with a hint of grassy-greenery and sweet char.

Palate: Gentle clouds of smoke intertwine with a very light fruit touch.

Finish: Short citrus notes and a final smoky symphony.

Delivery

Sign up to Fyne+ for a year of free next day delivery (geographic restrictions apply) on all your orders plus advanced access on new and limited releases, exclusive ballots and more! Just choose Fyne+ delivery during checkout or join here

Place your order before 1pm to take advantage of Next Day UK delivery to mainland UK. Orders to Highland postcodes can take an additional day to arrive. Islands & Northern Ireland orders take 3-4 working days. Find out more about UK delivery

For international deliveries, including the USA, use the 'Change Location' link above to estimate prices and delivery costs in your local currency. Find out more about international delivery

We care about our impact on the environment, so during checkout you can choose our Reduce & Recycle service to remove any unwanted gift cartons, tubes or boxes, from your order. We'll recylce wherever possible or return them to the manufacturer.

We send all of our orders with tracked courier services, allowing you to follow your parcel's journey to its destination. We'll send a link to your email when the order is dispatched.

Returns

If your item is damaged in transit or you receive an item that is clearly different to that ordered, please contact us within 24 hours of delivery. We will arrange a free return via courier and issue a full refund to your original payment method once we have received the returned items.

If you wish to cancel your order for any other reason, contact us within 14 days of delivery. You will be responsible for the cost of returning your items. Items must be returned within 14 days from the date of cancellation. Refunds will be issued to your original payment method when we receive the items.

Please note that any personalised, engraved, bespoke or made-to-order items, or items with a broken seal, are non-refundable unless faulty.

To arrange a return, please contact our Customer Services team.
